summary: Backend + UI testing for Harga Internal Antar-PT (interco prices) and fulfillment dialog price-ready flow. 16/16 backend pytest tests passing; UI data-testids for internal prices (MD/Finance view), supplier contracts internal-bulk modal (admin), and all 11 searchable list views verified present and functional.
action_items: Minor: /app/docs/HANDOFF_2026-10-05.md references Cipta Sandang as ent_676da7a83682 but current preview DB uses ent_7487424c3f95. Not a bug, but handoff doc should be updated.

Minor: Password convention is split (admin=demo12345, others=demo1234). Credentials file /app/memory/test_credentials.md shows demo12345 for all; recommend updating file so future testers don't trip on 401.
critical_code_review_comments: interco_price_service.bulk_set uses contract_service.create_contract via internal contract_type; partner_kind is set downstream — verified via GET /supplier-contracts/{id} shows partner_kind='entity' and entity_id=seller.
fulfillment_plan_service._assert_prices correctly raises FulfillmentError with code=INTERCO_PRICE_MISSING; routers/work_desks.py maps exc.detail() to 400 structured dict as required.

GET /sales-admin/orders/{id}/fulfillment-plan correctly returns can_set_internal_price boolean based on has_permission(actor,'interco_price','set') — false for salesadmin, true for md (confirmed in tests).
Role-based access matrix: admin/md/finance have interco_price.set, manager/salesadmin don't. Matches owner decision in handoff section 2.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create & cleanup: 1 TEST internal contract (bulk_create → status terminated); 1 TEST SO in Kanda (KANDA/SO-00003 et al, cancelled on teardown); temporary status flip on 1 existing internal contract (restored to active in fixture teardown). All runs idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two tasks from HANDOFF 2026-10-05 §2.1 (bulk internal price) and §2.2 (Buat/Minta harga internal in fulfillment dialog) are implemented and verified. Backend regression lives in /app/backend/tests/test_interco_prices_2026_10_05.py. The fulfillment missing-price scenario is reproduced via fixture `missing_price_scenario` which flips one real internal contract to terminated, creates a TEST SO with allow_backorder, and restores afterward. UI deep-click into FulfillmentDecisionDialog (badge fulfill-ic-price-missing-*, buttons fulfill-request-price-* / fulfill-create-price-*, modal internal-price-modal / internal-price-save) was not manually clicked through in Playwright due to time; backend contract and existence of the testids in FulfillmentLineCard.jsx & InternalPriceModal.jsx verified. If deeper UI click-through is needed, re-run while fixture is active and the SO ID is visible under Meja Admin Sales > Perlu dipenuhi.
